name: What are the common challenges to anticipate during a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges to anticipate during a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a kitchen addition include unexpected structural issues in the existing home, delays in permit approvals, changes to design plans mid-project, and material lead times. Weather can also impact construction schedules. Effective communication with your builder, detailed planning, and a contingency budget are essential to navigate these challenges smoothly. Opus Builders proactively addresses potential issues to minimize disruptions and keep the project on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Anticipate challenges like structural issues, permit delays, design changes, and material lead times; planning and communication are key.
